description: This Dart source file defines an AuthProvider class that manages authentication state within a Flutter application. It handles storing and retrieving the auth token from shared preferences, and provides methods for login, registration, logout, and token management, communicating with a backend via an API client.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A provider class extending ChangeNotifier to manage authentication state, token persistence, and communication with the backend authentication endpoints.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Getter for the current authentication token.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Boolean indicating if an authentication token is currently available.

methods.name: lastError
methods.description: Stores the latest error message from login or registration attempts.

methods.name: loadToken
methods.description: Loads the authentication token from shared preferences.

methods.name: _saveToken
methods.description: Persists the current token to shared preferences.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets a new token and persists it.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the token and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login by sending credentials to the backend and storing the returned token.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user and optionally sets the returned token.

methods.name: _humanizeError
methods.description: Converts caught exceptions into user-friendly error messages.
